Question: assalam-o-alaikum, My question is since 4 years passed we are not having any child, is this due to some reasons,coz last year my wife had some disorder of jinn not so harshlike but she had to face many problems in my house where we had to sleep and she use to face problem during poonim like she use to have dreams of some one who wants to kill or harm her or she has to have her entire body pains...please advice me as to what reasons after leaving my house till we are not having any children, allah hafiz Answer ID: 6266 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1201/1007=B/1429) It is in Allah?s Hand whether he gives children or not. There is no control of any aamil or jinn or Satan. Allah gives whom He likes and deprives those whom he wills. Hold this belief firmly and recite and blow Surah Al-Faalq, Surah Al-Naas and Surah Tariq in order to save yourself from bad dreams. However, if you see any bad dream then spit thrice on left side and recite أ عوذ باللہ من الشیطان الرجیم . In-sha-Allah, you shall be protected. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
